name: refrigeration_evaporator_wet_coil
title: Refrigeration evaporator with moist air, wet regime
summary: Air-cooled R134a evaporator of a refrigeration circuit running in the wet regime (condensation on the coil): imposed evaporating and condensing temperatures with superheat, subcooling and isenthalpic expansion on the refrigerant side, imposed air inlet and outlet states on the air side, and a 25 kW duty from which the two flow rates, the fictitious air-side capacity rate and the coil conductance are determined.

verification.reference: Solution stored in the original EES file (~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/... TP 05/MSTh-SB-R5-Ex2.EES, EES 7.458); the 11 variables cleared (-9999) in that solution are cross-checked against the design values quoted in the original
verification.notes: compare_solution.py (rtol=0.001): 22 common variables, 2 differ (h_1, h_3). Those two are absolute R134a enthalpies carrying a constant reference-state offset (+148.10 and +148.12 kJ/kg, EES default vs CoolProp IIR); their difference, the evaporator duty enthalpy drop, agrees within 0.017 %. The 20 other variables agree within 9.9e-4 (w_su). The 11 variables cleared (-9999) in the EES stored solution agree within 0.18 % (NTU_f) of the design values quoted in the original. No unit conversion needed (SI-C-Pa-J).
